definitions.explanation: Playing a supporting role in a film, play, or other performance. Most commonly seen in the context of awards and film credits.

examples.japanese: {助演|じょえん}⟦{男優|だんゆう}→男優：28277_danyuu⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He won the Best Supporting Actor award.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{女優|じょゆう}→女優：03353_joyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{助演|じょえん}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: That actress left a strong impression despite being in a supporting role.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{助演|じょえん}⟦{女優|じょゆう}→女優：03353_joyuu⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力派|じつりょくは}→実力派：30320_jitsuryokuha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ノミネート⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Talented young actresses have been nominated for this year's Best Supporting Actress award.

notes:
Compound of {助|じょ} (assist) + {演|えん} (perform). Refers to a supporting role in a film, play, or performance.

COMPOUNDS:
- {助演|じょえん}⟦{男優|だんゆう}→男優：28277_danyuu⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧: Best Supporting Actor award
- {助演|じょえん}⟦{女優|じょゆう}→女優：03353_joyuu⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧: Best Supporting Actress award
- {助演|じょえん}⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: supporting actor/actress

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主演|しゅえん}→主演：08254_shuen⟧: starring role, lead role
- {助演|じょえん}: supporting role
- ⟦{端役|はやく}→端役：24247_hayaku⟧: minor role, bit part
- ⟦{脇役|わきやく}→脇役：13933_wakiyaku⟧: supporting role (more colloquial synonym)

USAGE:
⟦{脇役|わきやく}→脇役：13933_wakiyaku⟧ is more commonly used in everyday conversation to mean "supporting role," while {助演|じょえん} appears mainly in award names and formal film/theater terminology.
